headline: Amazon online store sales grow 12% and North America profit jumps; Jassy says average prices on Amazon.com fell YoY.

metrics.comp_label: Online stores sales growth (ex-FX if available)

guidance_note: Q2 2026: net sales $194-199B (+16-19%), operating income $20-24B, assuming Prime Day in Q2. EPS shown is GAAP, incl. $16.8B pre-tax Anthropic gains.
key_messages: Online stores sales $64.3B, +12%; physical stores +5% to $5.8B.
North America sales $104.1B (+12%); segment operating income $8.3B vs $5.8B, margin ~8.0%.
Jassy said average prices on Amazon.com decreased versus the prior year.
Guidance assumes higher transportation costs tied to fuel inflation.

consumer.pricing: Average selling prices on Amazon.com lower YoY; fuel inflation raising transport costs.

macro_read: Double-digit online goods growth with lower average prices points to healthy US e-commerce unit demand in early 2026; fuel costs were the main inflation flag.

sources.label: Amazon Q1 2026 release (Business Wire via Seeking Alpha)
